gaps.explanation: No schedule lines for the proprietary funds. Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p7) prints Water Fund / Sewer Fund / Solid Waste Fund columns. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 945,910 + gain on sale of equipment 788 + interest income 5,908 + grant income 954. Added per column (amounts as printed; Water and Solid Waste interest income are printed negative, (79) and (9)): Water 288,063 + 2,531 + 4,651 + 716 - 79 + 954 = 296,836; Sewer 403,618 + 5,497 + 18,957 + 72 + 5,996 = 434,140; Solid Waste 217,698 + 1,742 + 3,153 - 9 = 222,584. 296,836 + 434,140 + 222,584 = 953,560 = statement total; gap 0.
